column1: dates|Dates & time|Build interfaces|calendar|Format a date|Format, parse, and work with dates across locales and timezones.|Date calculations and formatting are separate from the calendar UI used to choose a date.

drag-and-drop|Drag & drop|Build interfaces|move|Build a sortable list|Reorder a list, move cards between columns, or build a custom drop interaction.|Choose between list-oriented components and lower-level drag-and-drop primitives. Plan keyboard alternatives from the start.

data-tables|Data tables|Build interfaces|table|Explore a large dataset|Display a large dataset in a table with search, sorting, filtering, and editing.|A headless table supplies behavior while you build the UI. An integrated grid supplies more interface and its own customization boundaries.

forms|Forms & validation flows|Build interfaces|file-text|Build a form|Manage form state, validate fields, and guide users through submissions.|Compare field-state management, schema-driven generation, and progressive enhancement against the forms you actually need.

inputs|Inputs & selection|Build interfaces|sliders-horizontal|Choose and enter values|Collect values with selects, autocomplete, sliders, tags, and specialized inputs.|Check keyboard behavior, labels, and validation alongside the visual input style.

calendars|Calendars & date pickers|Build interfaces|calendar|Choose a date or schedule events|Select dates and ranges, display appointments, and navigate event calendars.|A date picker collects a value; an event calendar displays and manages schedules. Choose the interaction before the visual style.

ui-kits|UI kits & design systems|Build interfaces|layers|Build a consistent interface|Find complete component libraries, headless primitives, and copyable UI blocks.|Headless primitives give you styling control. Styled kits provide a coordinated visual system. Copyable components become code you maintain.

styling|Styling & themes|Build interfaces|palette|Style and theme components|Compose CSS classes, create design tokens, and build reusable component styles.|Check whether styles are generated at build time or runtime and how the approach fits your rendering setup.

layout|Panels & layout|Build interfaces|layout-grid|Arrange a workspace|Create resizable panels, responsive layouts, and growing content grids.|Test resizing, content overflow, and small screens with realistic data.

overlays|Dialogs, menus & tooltips|Build interfaces|layers|Show contextual controls|Build dialogs, contextual menus, popovers, and anchored tooltips.|Positioning utilities and complete dialogs solve different parts of the problem. Include focus management in your choice.

notifications|Notifications & loading|Build interfaces|bell|Show progress and feedback|Display toasts, loading indicators, desktop alerts, and browser push notifications.|Choose feedback that matches the task's urgency and duration without interrupting unrelated work.
icons|Icons|Build interfaces|shapes|Add interface icons|Find reusable icon collections and React icon components.|Choose a consistent visual style and import only the icons your interface needs.

animation|Animation & effects|Add interactions|sparkles|Animate an interaction|Create transitions, gesture effects, parallax, and expressive interface elements.|Use motion to explain state changes, and support people who prefer reduced motion.

media|Images, audio & video|Add interactions|image|Present interactive media|Display galleries, play audio, generate video, and process images.|Check supported media formats, loading behavior, and any server or hosted service requirements.

graphics|Canvas & interactive graphics|Add interactions|shapes|Build a visual canvas|Create drawings, diagrams, shader effects, and three-dimensional interactions.|Decide whether you need a full editor, scene-graph primitives, or a visual effect before selecting a library.

charts|Charts & visualization|Add interactions|chart-column|Visualize a dataset|Explain data with charts, heatmaps, timelines, and custom visualizations.|Ready-made charts accelerate common cases; lower-level primitives allow more control over presentation and interaction.

maps|Maps & location|Add interactions|map|Show locations on a map|Render maps, place markers, and work with location or postal data.|Check the mapping provider, data source, and supported coordinate or address formats.

editors|Rich text & code editors|Add interactions|file-text|Let users edit content|Add rich-text, Markdown, JSON, and code-editing experiences.|Choose the document model and storage format before adding editor features and toolbar controls.

code-highlighting|Code highlighting|Add interactions|code|Explain code visually|Highlight source code and create annotated or animated walkthroughs.|Check rendering targets, language support, and the amount of interactive explanation your content needs.

search|Search & autocomplete|Add interactions|search|Search a collection|Find approximate text matches, index documents, and build suggestion interfaces.|In-memory search fits local datasets. A search service handles a separate index. Autocomplete UI still needs a source of suggestions.

keyboard|Keyboard & command menus|Add interactions|keyboard|Add a command palette|Bind shortcuts and build keyboard-friendly command interfaces.|Keep shortcuts discoverable and avoid conflicts with browser, operating-system, and text-entry commands.

scrolling|Scrolling & scrollbars|Add interactions|move|Control a scrolling view|Bring content into view and customize scroll containers.|Prefer native scrolling behavior where possible and check that overlays do not shift the page.

onboarding|Tours & onboarding|Add interactions|route|Guide a new user|Introduce features with guided tours and multi-step onboarding.|Match guidance to a user's immediate task and let experienced users move through it quickly.

rich-content|Text & embedded content|Add interactions|file-text|Render rich content|Highlight matching text, balance headings, and embed external content.|Check how generated markup and embedded content behave with your rendering and content policies.

social-previews|Link previews & Open Graph|Add interactions|link|Preview a shared link|Generate social-sharing images and display cards for pasted URLs.|Metadata fetching may need a server or external service even when the preview is rendered in React.

state|State management|Manage application data|layers|Share application state|Coordinate local state, shared stores, URL state, and persistent client data.|Separate UI state from server data. Compare the update model and debugging experience with your team's needs.

data-fetching|Data fetching & server actions|Manage application data|arrow-left-right|Fetch and update server data|Call APIs, manage cached responses, and connect interface actions to the server.|An HTTP client sends requests; a server-state library also manages caching and synchronization with the UI.

routing|Routing & navigation|Manage application data|route|Navigate between screens|Connect URLs, navigation state, and application rendering.|Check route typing, data-loading conventions, and compatibility with your existing application framework.

validation|Runtime validation|Manage application data|shield-check|Validate incoming data|Check forms, API payloads, and configuration against explicit schemas.|Runtime validation checks external values; TypeScript types alone do not validate data at runtime.

typescript|TypeScript & typed logic|Manage application data|code|Make application logic type-safe|Express complex types, test declarations, and model application logic.|Choose utilities that make your domain easier to understand rather than adding type complexity without a clear benefit.

utilities|JavaScript & React utilities|Manage application data|wrench|Transform application data|Reuse helpers for collections, identifiers, browser behavior, and React integrations.|Prefer focused utilities for a concrete operation and check their runtime assumptions.

serialization|Serialization & JSON|Manage application data|braces|Move structured data|Serialize richer JavaScript values and prepare JSON payloads.|Confirm which value types survive serialization and how the receiving environment reconstructs them.

i18n|Internationalization|Manage application data|languages|Translate an application|Organize localized messages and language-specific routes.|Check message typing, locale loading, and how translated routes work with your rendering strategy.

performance|Performance & virtualization|Manage application data|gauge|Keep an interface responsive|Virtualize long lists, reduce repeated work, and inspect rendering costs.|Measure a realistic interaction first, then choose the tool that addresses the observed bottleneck.

files|Files, uploads & downloads|Manage application data|upload|Import or export a file|Upload files, export CSV, create archives, and work with file paths.|Browser file selection, server parsing, storage, and downloadable exports are separate stages of a file workflow.

auth|Authentication & identity|Connect services|key-round|Add user accounts|Integrate sign-in, sessions, organizations, and enterprise identity.|Choose between a hosted identity service and an application-owned authentication layer based on your requirements.

security|Sanitization & cryptography|Connect services|shield|Handle untrusted input safely|Sanitize markup and work with password hashing or cryptographic formats.|Use the library within a complete application design and follow its documented security assumptions.

databases|Databases & ORMs|Connect services|database|Store and query records|Choose a database platform, query builder, or object-relational mapper.|A database service hosts data; a query builder or ORM controls how application code accesses it.

backend|Backend services & content|Connect services|server|Add backend capabilities|Add databases, content management, APIs, storage, and realtime features.|Compare which services you need, where data lives, and the operational work you will own.

server|Servers & realtime|Connect services|server|Build an HTTP or realtime service|Handle requests, create WebSocket services, and collect webpage data.|Check supported runtimes and deployment targets before building around a server abstraction.

background-jobs|Background jobs & workers|Connect services|clock|Run work in the background|Schedule recurring tasks, queue jobs, process webhooks, and offload computation.|Choose between an in-process scheduler, a worker pool, and durable background infrastructure based on failure and retry needs.

hosting|Hosting & infrastructure|Connect services|cloud|Deploy an application|Host frontends, run server applications, and configure cloud infrastructure.|Match the deployment model to your runtime, storage, region, and operational requirements.

email|Email|Connect services|mail|Build an email template|Compose reusable email interfaces from application components.|Email clients have different rendering constraints from browsers. Test the actual generated email.

commerce|Commerce & customer workflows|Connect services|shopping-cart|Build a checkout or subscription flow|Connect storefronts, payments, billing, and customer conversations.|Separate the visual interface from payment processing, subscription state, and service integration.

analytics|Analytics & user insights|Connect services|chart-column|Understand product usage|Explore traffic, session behavior, and product adoption.|Decide what question you need to answer before collecting events or adding session replay.

ai|AI & conversational interfaces|Connect services|sparkles|Build an AI-powered feature|Connect models, create chat interfaces, and automate tasks with AI.|Distinguish model inference, application orchestration, and the conversation UI when choosing building blocks.

api-tools|API design & clients|Build and ship|braces|Design and test an API|Describe API contracts, inspect requests, generate clients, and publish references.|Keep the API contract and generated artifacts aligned with the server behavior they describe.

testing|Testing & mock data|Build and ship|flask-conical|Test a user workflow|Automate browsers, compare screenshots, mock APIs, and generate fixtures.|Test observable behavior with representative data and use mocks where they make failures easier to understand.

developer-tools|Developer tools & code health|Build and ship|wrench|Understand and improve a codebase|Inspect components, analyze dependencies, generate files, and apply code checks.|Choose tools that expose a concrete maintenance problem and integrate with your existing development workflow.

logging|Logging & observability|Build and ship|activity|Investigate application failures|Collect structured logs, track errors, and inspect recorded sessions.|Choose diagnostic signals that help explain real failures while controlling what application data is recorded.

cli|Command-line tools|Build and ship|terminal|Build a command-line workflow|Parse arguments, prompt users, run processes, and format terminal output.|Support both interactive use and non-interactive automation where the command needs to run in CI.

build-tools|Build tools & task runners|Build and ship|package|Build and run a project|Bundle code, analyze builds, and coordinate development processes.|Check runtime targets, output formats, and how tasks depend on one another.

packages|Package development & releases|Build and ship|package|Publish a library|Build packages, inspect dependencies, validate exports, and automate releases.|Test a packed package in a consumer project before publishing it.

frameworks|Frameworks & starters|Explore the ecosystem|layers|Start an application|Compare application frameworks, starter kits, and specialized project scaffolds.|A framework sets long-lived conventions. Try a small feature that exercises routing, data, and deployment before committing.

mobile|Mobile, desktop & shared apps|Explore the ecosystem|smartphone|Share code across platforms|Build native-style applications and coordinate shared web and mobile behavior.|Check platform-specific interaction, navigation, and packaging requirements in addition to shared UI code.

documentation|Documentation & publishing|Explore the ecosystem|book-open|Publish a documentation site|Create documentation, technical blogs, and navigable Markdown content.|Compare authoring workflows, content structure, search, and the hosting model your project needs.

open-source-apps|Open-source applications|Explore the ecosystem|app-window|Study a complete application|Explore real applications and reference implementations.|Use a repository to study concrete patterns, then check its license and current project status before reuse.

learning|Learning & references|Explore the ecosystem|book-open|Learn a development concept|Find documentation, tutorials, architecture examples, and practice resources.|Use current official documentation to confirm version-specific details found in tutorials and older examples.

community|Communities & publishing platforms|Explore the ecosystem|users|Connect with other developers|Find technical communities, discussion spaces, and developer publishing platforms.|Choose a community or publishing workflow that matches the topics and depth you want to explore.
